summary: Ripple Ventures is a Toronto-based inception-stage investor in founders building advanced technologies, and announced its fourth fund. Its homepage states a cheque size of $250,000 to $1,000,000, a stage that can be pre-incorporation, pre-product or pre-traction, a typical lead or co-lead role, and a geography of Canadian and US startups selling to global markets. Portfolio entries are tagged deep tech and AI plus science or services. A pitch route and a street address are not stated on the homepage.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage lists portfolio companies tagged deep tech, AI and science, and AI and services, mostly in Toronto; individual rounds and dates are not stated on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: cheque size, stage, round involvement, geography and portfolio tags
